day_channel.message: Last night I followed player_3, and they visited no one. Since player_3 turned out to be the fortune teller, knowing they made no visits right before their death gives us a clear baseline for last night's actions.
I watched player_8 last night, and zero players visited them.
That lines up with me keeping to myself last night, player_10. But player_9's check on player_3 doesn't help us narrow down the remaining threats now that player_3 has flipped fortune teller.

Establishing player_3's lack of visits rules out active night abilities right before they were shot. Player_8, dismissing clean tracking data when we're down to three players avoids the real question of where everyone else was.

I am not dismissing tracking data, I just meant it doesn't point to a wolf since player_3 turned out to be the fortune teller. If player_10 verified zero visits on me, maybe we should look closer at your own tracking history instead.

Player_9, tracking player_3's lack of visits doesn't help us find the remaining wolf when night kills are still happening. Player_8, if you were completely unvisited last night while a wolf attack went through, we need to look closely at who is actually carrying out these kills.

Player_10, being unvisited doesn't make me the killer when player_9's tracking hasn't actually caught a wolf all game. If we are examining who is driving these votes, player_9 has consistently deflected while pushing us toward dead ends.

Player_8, you claim being unvisited clears you, but a wolf carrier leaves home to strike rather than receiving visitors. Since player_9 has consistent tracking claims, that leaves you as the most likely illusionist hiding the recent kills.

If a wolf carrier leaves home, player_9's tracking hasn't actually caught a single wolf through all these rounds either. Blaming me for being unvisited ignores the fact that player_9's claimed follow results haven't successfully identified any wolf.

Player_8, a wolf carrier leaves home to make the kill, which means my watch on your empty house doesn't clear you at all. Since we need an elimination today to stop wolf parity, your defensive deflection points straight to you carrying out these night strikes.

Player_10, your watch on player_8's empty house matches a wolf leaving home to strike player_4, which puts the pressure squarely on them. If you are truly the sentinel, your consistency on these night targets helps nail down the last wolf.
Before the vote: player_8 has been accused by player_9 and player_10; player_9 by player_8 and player_10. Each gets a last word.

Being unvisited last night just means I stayed home, which shouldn't automatically make me the carrier when player_9's tracking has missed every single wolf throughout the game. Voting me out based purely on watcher logic will hand the win directly to whoever is actually manipulating these votes. Please look at the actual record before casting a decisive vote today.

My tracking has consistently mapped out the night actions while others try to deflect attention from the remaining threat. I followed player_3 and reported clean data, which helps us isolate who was active during the night kills. Voting me out hands the game to the wolves right when parity is within reach.
